data.current_summary: Call the public Cohesivity MCP server for documentation and management, with optional account OAuth
data.current_description: One MCP Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint serves Cohesivity documentation and management. Without Authorization, initialize, ping, tools/list, and tools/call are public; no guest identity, token, or session is created. The server exposes exactly six tools: get_cohesivity_documentation plus five management tools, create_tenant, claim_tenant, tenant_status, provision_resource, and give_feedback. get_cohesivity_documentation is read-only, needs no tenant, credentials, confirmation, or OAuth scope, and reads only fixed Cohesivity pages selected by document and offering. Public create_tenant takes only confirmed: true; each call creates a new rate-limited 72-hour ephemeral tenant, with no idempotency_key and no browser download URL. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous creation outcome. Reuse an existing .cohesivity. Hosted claim_tenant, tenant_status, provision_resource, and give_feedback each require an explicit tenant_id; public calls also require its secret coh_management_key from .cohesivity as a writeOnly argument, verified against current tenant state. Provisioning accepts single resource/configuration or bulk resources/configurations. Creation, claim, and provisioning require confirmed: true after explicit authorization for the exact action; give_feedback submits feedback without user confirmation. Hosted create_tenant returns credentials_file with filename .cohesivity and exact file content in structuredContent and the compatible text result. This secret-bearing result and key-bearing tool inputs may enter model or client retained tool history. Save content verbatim with mode 0600 and gitignore it; never overwrite a different tenant or print credentials in chat, logs, or source. Report if the client cannot write safely. Optional account-scoped OAuth preserves the existing scopes and ownership checks: each tenant tool re-checks current access, OAuth creation requires idempotency_key and mcp:tenants:create, and account creation atomically claims the tenant with no expiry. OAuth tools do not accept management keys in arguments. Existing legacy guest tokens remain limited to their own still-ephemeral creations. Invalid Authorization returns 401; it must never fall back to public access. Other tool results are scrubbed; no other control-plane tools or operation handles are exposed. Local MCP output remains metadata-only. /mcp/manage is retired and returns 410; it is not an alias.
data.summary_suggestion: Execute MCP tools for tenant and resource management
data.description_suggestion: Executes JSON-RPC requests against the Cohesivity MCP server. Public access (no Authorization) supports: initialize, ping, tools/list, tools/call, and get_cohesivity_documentation (read-only). Authenticated access (managementKey or OAuth token) enables: create_tenant, claim_tenant, tenant_status, provision_resource, and give_feedback. Public create_tenant creates a new 72-hour ephemeral tenant; authenticated create_tenant with idempotency_key and mcp:tenants:create scope atomically claims the tenant with no expiry. All tenant operations require explicit tenant_id and coh_management_key (public) or OAuth verification. Provisioning accepts single or bulk resource configurations. Creation, claim, and provisioning require confirmed: true authorization. Returns credentials_file (.cohesivity) for create_tenant; save with mode 0600 and never print credentials in logs or chat. Invalid Authorization returns 401.

data.current_summary: Download a private project credentials file in the authorized browser
data.current_description: The credentials_download_url from OAuth create_tenant is an address, not a bearer capability. It is an optional fallback for OAuth clients with no writable workspace, not a prerequisite for coding clients that save the authorized hosted create_tenant credentials_file response. Public creation returns no browser download URL. Download requires the legacy consent browser guest cookie for its own active, unexpired, still-ephemeral tenant, or an account session that currently owns the active claimed tenant. Guest access ends after claim; reconnect with the owning account. OAuth bearer tokens, tenant keys, and the URL alone do not authorize download. Query strings and cross-site fetches are rejected. Save the secret attachment verbatim as a gitignored .cohesivity file with mode 0600, without overwriting a different tenant; never print it in chat, logs, or source, or commit it.
data.description_suggestion: Downloads the .cohesivity credentials file for an authorized tenant. Requires either: (1) a valid mcpGuestSession cookie for an active, unexpired, still-ephemeral tenant created by the guest, or (2) a cohesivitySession for an account that currently owns the claimed tenant. Guest access is revoked after tenant claim; use account session to download after claiming. This endpoint is an optional fallback for OAuth clients without writable workspace; coding clients should save the credentials_file from create_tenant response directly. Query strings and cross-site requests are rejected. Save the attachment verbatim as a gitignored .cohesivity file with mode 0600; never print credentials in logs, chat, or source control.

data.current_description: Public-client token endpoint. Authorization codes require PKCE S256. Refresh tokens rotate transactionally and replay revokes the token family.
